headline: Six Sectors Keep the Front Ledger Moving
war_summary: The latest returns show the fighting concentrated in a narrower band of unsettled sectors. Linn Mercy remains the busiest ledger, with 42 base events in 24 hours and 10 in the last two; its holdings stand at three Warden, seven Colonial, and one neutral. Weathered Expanse has edged up to 45 daily events, including four in the latest watch, while its map records one Warden, five Colonial, and three neutral bases. Nevish Line has likewise quickened to 51 daily events and six in two hours, with two Warden, five Colonial, and one neutral. Mooring County has risen from the previous edition’s 15 events to 19, though only three came in the latest two hours; it holds eleven Warden and one Colonial base. Marban Hollow is now an active watch, recording 11 events, with four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral position. Callahans Passage retains heavy casualty traffic and nine daily base events, but no movement in the latest two hours. Stonecradle’s 14 events remain an older flare, with no fresh change in the current window.
